There it was.
A small pouch sat all alone on a desk, as if someone had left it behind.
My heart gave a jolt.
Could the ampoule be inside it?
The pouch was tied tightly shut with a cord.
With fingers slippery with sweat, I fumbled impatiently at the knot.
Then I shoved my hand inside.{p}
rows.07:1cc40:
"Ow★"
A searing pain shot through my finger.
When I looked, there was a cut.
Blood was pouring out of it.
Someone had planted a razor blade inside the pouch.
What a vicious, underhanded trick.
It had to be Hino and his gang.
Using my mouth and my free hand, I somehow managed to cover the wound with my handkerchief.
The throbbing pain pounded inside my head.
The cut seemed to be deeper than it looked.
In no time at all, the handkerchief was soaked red.
I felt like I was about to pass out.
Now I had to hurry even more than before.
If the bleeding didn't stop, my body would give out before the poison even had a chance to spread.{p}
